reason: Paylocity sells cloud HCM and payroll software that unifies HR, finance and IT. RingCentral sells cloud communications and AI voice software: phone, video, messaging and contact center. The products serve different functions. Both are subscription SaaS sold to businesses, but the customers are only generically alike, and the buyer need and budget owner differ (HR and payroll vs. communications and customer service).
reason_if_0: Different industry: HCM and payroll software vs. unified communications and contact center software. There is no product overlap, and the customer overlap is only generic businesses.
